description: This file defines a ProducerProcessor class that filters, transforms, and distributes frames in a processing pipeline, along with an identity transformer function.

classes.name: ProducerProcessor
classes.description: A processor that filters frames and distributes them to multiple consumers, optionally transforming frames and passing them through downstream.

methods.name: add_consumer(self)
methods.description: Adds a new consumer queue for distributing frames, returning the asyncio.Queue instance.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame, applying filtering, optional transformation, and distributing to consumers; can also pass frames downstream depending on passthrough setting.

methods.name: _produce(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Internal method to send a transformed frame to all registered consumer queues.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, filter: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[bool]], transformer: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[Frame]] = identity_transformer, passthrough: bool = True, )

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, *, filter: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[bool]], transformer: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[Frame]] = identity_transformer, passthrough: bool = True, )

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
